about: The showcase packs (tools/build_packs.mjs): what a new browser starts with, and States ▾ › New from a blueprint…. Paths are relative to this file.

packs.title: Organizer demo
packs.about: A life organizer: six areas of a life, tasks with due dates, routines that come back, and bigger goals broken into steps.

packs.title: Statistics essentials
packs.about: A study aid: 36 questions in six topics, answered on the map. Choices and the order shuffle each session; a goal appears after three right answers.

packs.title: Intro to data analysis
packs.about: A course map: six units of lessons, a project at each unit’s tip that opens the next steps, and short checks on the way. In three projects, two core steps done unlock the stretch work.

packs.title: Home cooking skill tree
packs.about: A skill tree: basics on the central star, and each category’s signature skill unlocks a star of advanced ones when it’s done.

packs.title: The Lantern Coast
packs.about: A campaign notebook: six factions of a made-up coast, their people and places, notes, and how they feel about each other.

packs.title: Trivia night
packs.about: A game: six rounds of twenty questions, a few on the field at a time. Answer three right in a round and a goal question twinkles; answer it to win the round.
